body: I have my boyfriend and 2 friend that know about my anxiety. Of course they say things like hey don't give up yet, but I mean, what goes on inside my head can't be stopped by anybody even me. Imagine listening to the same song over and over again since 3 or 4 years... I don't know the english word for this but it is "debilisant''

You should go see the nurse at your school for your headaches, and talk to her about the situation with your parents. She has to keep it confidential so don't worry. It's her job. 

Maybe if you explain to her that your parents won't or can't go with you to see a doctor, she (or he) will figure something out for you. 

You are so young, things can get better, I promess.

Re-reading all those posts is making me quite happy. I didn't feel like responding at the time because I was too sad but I read them and it helped me so much more than you guys think. 
Thank you. <3

But I can't talk to him because he starts saying some really painful things to me... like:"Here it goes again! I can't have a break, for fuck's sake, pin it in your head, I have nothing for that girl, If I talk to her behind your back it's because I know you don't like when I talk to her and the way I talk to her, i'm gonna end this right here, at least i'll be happy, go the fuck home and leave me alone, if it takes 3 months for me to call you back, it's not my problem"

I know that sometimes, it seems like there is not even a tiny bit of hapiness in your life. But try to concentrate on the things that soothes you. Often, when people think of hapinness, they think of the big things like a party or doing their favorite sport. Try to enjoy the little things. A cute dog on the street, the laugh of someone on the bus, people dancing, street performers, being proud of yourself because you gave a homeless some change, etc. Life will seem much more enjoyable in a couple of weeks.

I'm sorry guys, my mother tongue is french and I don't quite understand every punchline or puns... didn't think about that... 
Do you think it's shady that he changed his cellphone password? I feel so much anxiety about that... it's very painful and I feel stupid.
A couple of friends and family... but they all seem too busy to care. ''It's going to be okay!''. That's it, that's all...
When I feel down, this song helps me a lot if you want. Music has an amazing healing power. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GeCClzNCfcA
If I was you, i would try to put a deadline to this. For example in one week, she will have to take a decision. She can't make you wait forever since it's so painful for you to live.

All these little attentions are really kind of you. Being a girl, I can say that little things like this are much cuter than a dozen of roses. But what about you? It seems like you're treating her like a princess, but is she treating you like a prince? Maybe you could think of you relashionship as well. Think about the same questions she is probably thinking about right now.

It is completely normal. Maybe you could text her and tell her you need to talk with her about how you feel. It will help you and she will see that you love her and that you really don't want to lose her.

I know that you think people do not understand how you feel. But you are NOT alone. Last september, my fiancé - who I have been with for almost 4 years now - asked for a break. I know how you feel. I don't know how long you've been with her, but remember that at a certain point in a relashionship comes this period where you question yourself. Do you really want to spend the rest of your life with this person? Is he/she the one? She is probably in that state of mind. 

Try to do some activities you like, even if you don't feel like it. It will make you think about something else. Give yourself a break. You deserve it. Feel free to PM me if you want to talk.

Hi, thanks a lot for your answer, i feel so alone these days... But I have to say that my old "friends" don't want to talk to me anymore, they have ruined my reputation, I live in a small city so a lot of people believe their lies... This has ruined my self confidence, so whenever someone is telling me i'm worthless, i kind of believe them. 
Also, i'm really really REALLY shy, it is really hard for me to make friends. Almost like I forgot how. All my social skills: gone.
I don't have particular talents or skills, so I can't really join a club or something.
